title: Joy & Gratitude
intro: Small children are naturally delighted and naturally ungrateful, both at full volume. This month leans into the first and gently builds the second — noticing out loud, saying thank you, and learning that gladness is not the same as getting your way.

keyScriptures.text: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

weeks.title: Today Is a Gift
weeks.declaration: Today was made and given to you. It is not owed to anyone, which is exactly what makes it good.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, let this family notice today rather than rushing past it. Amen.

weeks.title: Saying Thank You
weeks.declaration: Thank you is a small thing to say and it changes the person saying it. We will practise it here.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make gratitude a habit in this house rather than a rule we enforce. Amen.

weeks.title: Glad Is Not Getting Your Way
weeks.declaration: You can be happy even when you did not get what you wanted. That takes practice and it is worth having.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, teach our child a gladness that does not depend on getting their way. Amen.

weeks.title: Laughing Together
weeks.declaration: There is a lot of laughing in this family, and you are part of why. May you remember that.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, fill this house with laughter our child remembers when they are grown. Amen.

days.title: Today Is a Gift
days.declaration: Today was made and given to you. Nobody was owed it.

scripture.text: This is the day the Lord has made.

days.title: Say Thank You
days.declaration: Thank you is small to say and it makes people glad. Say it lots.

scripture.text: Give thanks in all circumstances.

days.title: Find One Good Thing
days.declaration: There is something good in today. Find it and say it out loud.

scripture.text: Whatever is true, whatever is noble... think about such things.

days.title: Glad Without Getting Your Way
days.declaration: You can be happy even when you did not get what you wanted. That is a big thing to learn.

scripture.text: I have learned to be content.

days.title: Everything Good Is a Gift
days.declaration: Everything good came from somewhere. God gave it.

scripture.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above.

days.title: Laughing Is Good for You
days.declaration: Laughing is good for you. God made it on purpose.

scripture.text: A cheerful heart is good medicine.

days.title: Small Things Are Most Things
days.declaration: Warm food, a story, someone to hold. Most of a good day is small.

scripture.text: Forget not all his benefits.

days.title: Thank the People
days.declaration: Tell people thank you while they are standing there. Do not save it.

scripture.text: And be thankful.

days.title: You Have Enough
days.declaration: You have enough today. Noticing that is what being grateful means.

scripture.text: Godliness with contentment is great gain.

days.title: Singing
days.declaration: Singing makes a day better. Sing even if it sounds funny.

scripture.text: Come before him with joyful songs.

days.title: Glad for Someone Else
days.declaration: When someone else gets a turn or a treat, you can be glad for them.

scripture.text: Rejoice with those who rejoice.

days.title: Wanting Everything
days.declaration: Wanting everything makes you enjoy nothing. Wanting less works better.

scripture.text: Be content with what you have.

days.title: Grateful on a Bad Day
days.declaration: Even on a bad day there is something to be thankful for. It does not make the bad bit fake.

scripture.text: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord.

days.title: God Is Glad About You
days.declaration: God is glad about you. That is a reason to be happy that never runs out.

scripture.text: He will rejoice over you with singing.

days.title: Say It at Dinner
days.declaration: At dinner we will each say one good thing. That is a habit worth keeping.

scripture.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.

days.title: Made to Enjoy Things
days.declaration: God made things taste nice and feel nice on purpose. Enjoy them.

scripture.text: God richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.

days.title: Thankful for People
days.declaration: People are the best presents. Notice who you have got.

scripture.text: I thank my God every time I remember you.

days.title: Not Comparing
days.declaration: Looking at what someone else has makes you sad. Look at what you have.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions.

days.title: Playing Is Good
days.declaration: Playing is not a waste of time. God made you to play.

scripture.text: The streets will be filled with boys and girls playing.

days.title: Thank You Before
days.declaration: You can say thank you before you get it, if you know it is coming.

scripture.text: With thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

days.title: A New Day
days.declaration: Every morning starts again. Yesterday does not have to come with you.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Being Cheerful Helps
days.declaration: A cheerful face makes other people feel better. You can give that away for free.

scripture.text: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart.

days.title: Giving Makes You Glad
days.declaration: Giving something away makes you gladder than keeping it. It is strange and true.

scripture.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

days.title: Thankful for Your Body
days.declaration: Your legs run and your hands hold. Say thank you for what your body does.

scripture.text: I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: Remembering Good Days
days.declaration: Remembering a good day makes you happy twice.

scripture.text: I will remember the deeds of the Lord.

days.title: Enough to Share
days.declaration: There is enough here to share. You will not run out.

scripture.text: My God will meet all your needs.

days.title: Thankful for Home
days.declaration: Having somewhere to come home to is a big gift. Not everyone has one.

scripture.text: God sets the lonely in families.

days.title: Joy Nobody Can Take
days.declaration: There is a happy that nobody can take away, because nobody gave it to you.

scripture.text: No one will take away your joy.

days.title: More Good Coming
days.declaration: More good things are coming. God has not run out of them.

scripture.text: No good thing does he withhold.

days.title: Glad You Are Here
days.declaration: We are glad you are here. That is not because of anything you did.

scripture.text: Children are a heritage from the Lord.

days.title: Noticing Tomorrow Too
days.declaration: We will keep noticing good things tomorrow. It is what we do here.

scripture.text: Rejoice always.
